'''Bellym Karr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who worked in [[Drazaal Row]], on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:TLoN" /> Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and [[Talos Drellik]] visited Karr to acquire a part for an antique [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and therefore get access to [[Darth Nul's Laboratory]] on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]].<ref name="TOR:TLoN" />
